ARMY 101: Army 101 focuses on introduction to the Army and basic Soldier skills.
ARMY 102: Army 102 introduces Cadets to the personal challenges and competencies that are critical for effective leadership.
ARMY 103: This course is designed to guide students through an intentional physical fitness program.
ARMY 201: Army 201 focuses on leadership and ethics.
ARMY 202: Army 202 focuses on Army doctrine and decision making.
ARMY 301: Army 301 focuses on training management and the warfighting functions.
ARMY 302: Army 302 focuses on applied leadership in small unit operations.
ARMY 401: Army 401 focuses on development of the Army Officer.
ARMY 402: Army 402 is an academically challenging course where you will develop knowledge, skills, and abilities required of junior officers pertaining to the Army in Unified Land Operations and Company Grade Officer roles and responsibilities.
ARMY 496: Creative projects, including research and design, which are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.
